meta.name: integrate
meta.description: Build or change a customer-system integration with explicit data mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation. Use for connectors, imports, write-back and upstream APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把外部系统的数据接通,让导入、回写和同步按规则稳定跑完
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 要把自家产品与外部系统打通并保证同步不出错
copy.tagline_en: Connect a customer system's data so imports, write-backs and syncs run by rule
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to wire your product to an external system and keep data in sync reliably

howto.what: 它会帮你搭建或修改与客户系统的集成:明确数据映射、权限、重试与对账,产出连接器、导入、回写或对接上游 API 的方案与改动。
howto.when: 当你要求做连接器、导入、回写等客户系统对接时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其现有上下文和范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我设计一个从客户 CRM 导入联系人到我们系统的集成
say.note: 它会给出数据映射、权限与重试方案

say.text: 给这个集成加上失败重试和对账逻辑
say.note: 它会补上重试与对账部分

say.text: 把我们的数据回写到客户的上游 API
say.note: 它会梳理回写路径与权限

howto.what_en: It helps you build or change a customer-system integration with explicit data mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation, covering connectors, imports, write-back and upstream APIs.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a connector, import, write-back or other customer-system integration; if invoked by @fde, it reuses that existing context and scope.

say_en.text: Design an integration that imports contacts from the customer's CRM
say_en.note: It outlines data mapping, permissions and retries

say_en.text: Add failure retries and reconciliation to this integration
say_en.note: It fills in the retry and reconciliation parts

say_en.text: Write our data back to the customer's upstream API
say_en.note: It covers the write-back path and permissions
